title: Just One KISS repository image engineering inventory
purpose: Machine-readable handoff for expert marketing, design, and coding sessions. Every discovered raster/vector image is indexed; the /proto/public runtime is the visual benchmark, while concepts, screenshots, source photography and third-party references are clearly separated.

method: pixel dimensions and MIME via PHP getimagesize where supported
direct visual inspection of runtime hero/support assets, performer photography and representative families
cross-check against runtime templates, CSS, image-generation inventory and existing style report
limitations: Descriptions are engineering/creative observations, not legal clearance.
Opaque layer-upload names have no inferred approval.
Website screenshots are evidence snapshots, not reusable source artwork.

canonical_standard.north_star: The active /proto/public site: black first, chrome second, fire third, mythic scale always; practical information remains exceptionally clear.
composition: near-black stage void provides negative space
symmetrical or strongly anchored portal/object silhouette
hard chrome specular edges and industrial framing
red/orange fire light supplies urgency; bone-white and yellow support facts
fog/haze makes beams dimensional without obscuring essential content
oversized condensed display hierarchy paired with plain readable utility text
content_contract: Lead with one dominant idea, one focal silhouette and one next action.
Separate expressive imagery from live HTML/text facts wherever possible.
Recompose for each ratio; never blind-crop central figures, hands, instruments, flames or factual panels.
Preserve a clear dark copy zone and test overlays at mobile and desktop breakpoints.
Do not imply official affiliation; do not publish exact protected marks, album art, official logos or uncleared likenesses.
Operational authenticity—truss, road cases, cables, controls, armor construction—must look intentional, controlled and plausible.

palette_roles.chrome: structure, proof, precision and premium craft
palette_roles.green: minor live-light counterpoint only, never the core brand color

do_not: unreadable type baked into generated images
unverified map directions or event facts
casual workshop/reference backgrounds in finished campaigns
AI artifacts in faces, hands, instruments, hardware, typography or cables
